# Bliss Path Tours & Safaris
> Official Website: https://blisspathtours.com
> Brand Motto: "Guided by passion, blessed by nature."

Bliss Path Tours & Safaris is a premier, native East African tour operator and safari outfitter based in Nairobi, Kenya. We specialize in bespoke, 100% tailor-made private wildlife safaris, Great Wildebeest Migration expeditions, endangered Mountain Gorilla trekking, Mount Kilimanjaro summit climbs, and tropical Indian Ocean beach holidays across Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda.

## Company Information & Entity Details
- Legal Name: Bliss Path Tours & Safaris Ltd.
- Headquarters: Off outering road, Next to fedha Quickmart Ongata Rongai
- Operating Hours: Monday – Saturday, 07:00 – 21:00 East Africa Time (EAT) / 24/7 Emergency Safari Concierge
- Primary Telephone / WhatsApp: 0741319503 / 0721573509
- Official Inquiries Email: info@blisspathtours.com
- Industry Accreditations & Licensing:
  - Licensed by Tourism Regulatory Authority (TRA/KEN)
  - Member of Kenya Association of Tour Operators (KATO)
  - EcoTourism Kenya Certified Partner
  - Magical Kenya Official Partner

## Vehicle Fleet & Operating Standards
- Vehicles: Purpose-built 4x4 Toyota Land Cruisers outfitted with 360° pop-up photography roofs, heavy-duty suspension, long-range dual fuel tanks, UHF radio communication, individual USB camera/phone charging inverters, and onboard electric refrigerators with chilled bottled water.
- Seating: Guaranteed window seat for every traveler (maximum 6 guests per vehicle). No minivans used on bush game drives.
- Guides: Native Kenyan and East African naturalist driver-guides certified Gold and Silver by the Kenya Professional Safari Guides Association (KPSGA), each with 15+ years bush tracking experience.

## Key Safari Knowledge & Timings
- Great Migration: An ongoing 365-day circular movement of 1.5 million wildebeest and 250,000 zebras between the Serengeti (Tanzania) and Masai Mara (Kenya).
  - Jan–Mar: Southern Serengeti (Ndutu) calving season (8,000+ calves born daily, intense big cat activity).
  - Jul–Oct: Northern Serengeti & Masai Mara (iconic Mara River crossings).
  - Interactive Migration Calendar: https://blisspathtours.com/migration-guide
- Mountain Gorilla Trekking: Regulated by Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA). Strictly 1 hour permitted with a habituated gorilla family. Minimum age is 15 years.
- Best Dry Seasons: June to October and December to March across East Africa.
